statement.name: GetUserFavorites
statement.sql:
SELECT F.FAVRItemId as FavoriteId ,F.Description ,UF.DisplayText ,F.PageTypeCode ,UF.UserId ,UF.FAVRUserItemId as UserFavoriteId ,UF.AdditionalParams ,U.RelativeURL as URL ,U.ExternalSystemCode ,U.ExternalSystemDimensionCode ,E.DimensionValue as ExternalSystemDimensionValue ,CG.LookupCode as FavoriteCategoryCode ,CG.DisplayValue as CategoryDescription ,DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, 0, UF.CreatedDate), 0) as CreatedDate ,CG.DisplayOrder as CategoryDisplayOrder ,F.WindowType ,UF.FAVRTypeCode as FavoriteTypeCode ,T.DisplayValue as FavoriteTypeDesc
FROM LU_PFM_FAVR_Item F Join PFM_CORE_PredefinedPage U on U.COREPredefinedPageID = F.COREPredefinedPageID Join dbo.ExternalSystemDimensionValue E on U.ExternalSystemCode = E.ExternalSystemCode and U.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = E.ExternalSystemDimensionCode Join PFM_FAVR_UserItem UF on UF.FAVRItemId = F.FAVRItemId join LU_PFM_FAVR_Category CG on CG.LookupCode = F.CategoryCode join LU_PFM_FAVR_Type T on T.LookupCode = UF.FAVRTypeCode
AND UF.DisplayText is not null

statement.name: GetTopUserFavorites
statement.sql:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT F.FAVRItemId as FavoriteId, F.Description ,UF.DisplayText ,F.PageTypeCode ,UF.UserId ,UF.FAVRUserItemId as UserFavoriteId ,UF.AdditionalParams ,U.RelativeURL as URL ,U.ExternalSystemCode ,U.ExternalSystemDimensionCode ,E.DimensionValue as ExternalSystemDimensionValue ,CG.LookupCode as FavoriteCategoryCode ,CG.DisplayValue as CategoryDescription ,DATEADD(DAY, DATEDIFF(DAY, 0, UF.CreatedDate), 0) as CreatedDate ,CG.DisplayOrder as CategoryDisplayOrder ,F.WindowType ,UF.FAVRTypeCode as FavoriteTypeCode ,T.DisplayValue as FavoriteTypeDesc, Row_Number() over (Partition BY F.CategoryCode ORDER BY UF.CreatedDate DESC ) AS Rank FROM LU_PFM_FAVR_Item F Join PFM_CORE_PredefinedPage U on U.COREPredefinedPageID = F.COREPredefinedPageID Join dbo.ExternalSystemDimensionValue E on U.ExternalSystemCode = E.ExternalSystemCode and U.ExternalSystemDimensionCode = E.ExternalSystemDimensionCode Join PFM_FAVR_UserItem UF on UF.FAVRItemId = F.FAVRItemId join LU_PFM_FAVR_Category CG on CG.LookupCode = F.CategoryCode join LU_PFM_FAVR_Type T on T.LookupCode = UF.FAVRTypeCode AND FAVRTypeCode=1
AND UF.DisplayText is not null ) rs

statement.name: GetFavoriteItem
statement.sql: SELECT *, pt.DisplayValue as DisplayValue FROM LU_PFM_FAVR_Item item JOIN LU_PFM_FAVR_PageType pt on pt.LookupCode = item.PageTypeCode

statement.name: GetUserItemFavorite
statement.sql:
DECLARE @pageTypeCode as int
SET @pageTypeCode = ( SELECT PageTypeCode FROM LU_PFM_FAVR_Item
)
IF (@pageTypeCode = 0) BEGIN
SELECT *, 0 as PageTypeCode, 'Static' as PageTypeDisplayValue FROM PFM_FAVR_UserItem
END ELSE BEGIN
SELECT *, 0 as PageTypeCode, 'Dynamic' as PageTypeDisplayValue FROM PFM_FAVR_UserItem
END

if Not Exists( select * from PFM_FAVR_UserItem
) BEGIN if Exists( select * from LU_PFM_FAVR_Item
)
SELECT @categoryFavoriteCount = Count(1) FROM PFM_FAVR_UserItem U , LU_PFM_FAVR_Item I WHERE U.FAVRItemId=I.FAVRItemId and UserId = '' GROUP BY CategoryCode HAVING categorycode=(SELECT categorycode FROM LU_PFM_FAVR_Item WHERE FAVRItemId='')
set @categoryFavoriteCount = ISNull(@categoryFavoriteCount,0)
INSERT INTO PFM_FAVR_UserItem
newid()
GetDate()
GetDate()
CASE WHEN (@categoryFavoriteCount < ) THEN 1 ELSE 2 END
END
